hints.title: Bi-directional Mapping
hints.text: Map index to current number, and map number to a collection of its assigned indices.

hints.title: Lazy Deletion in Min Heap
hints.text: When changing the number at an index, update the index map. Add the index to the new number's min heap, and lazily discard outdated indices upon finding.

hints.title: Clean Minimum Retrieval
hints.text: When calling find, pop invalid top indices from the min heap until the top index actually maps to that number, or the heap empties.

hints.title: Min Heap with Lazy Pruning Implementation

complexity.time: O(log n) for change, amortized O(log n) for find
complexity.notes: Each change inserts into heap; lazy popping discards stale entries once.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Scanning all indices on each find takes O(n) per query.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Dual hash map and min heaps balance update and query speeds.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Employs lazy deletion with min heaps or ordered sets to achieve logarithmic operations.
